item.unicode: North San Diego Bay - Private Sunset Cruise
item.description:
##Duration					
1 Hour

##About
Enjoy San Diego in a different light. Experience the evening on the bay as the water glows from the sun setting and bouncing off of it. An amazing day to unwind, go on a date night or do something different for a change.

##What to Bring					
Bring warm clothes, as they cool down on the water once the sun sets. We have blankets available for purchase as well! Please also bring an ID if you are 21+ and plan to consume alcohol while onboard.

Guest of the Kona Kai San Diego? [Click Here To Make your Reservation](https://www.resortkonakai.com/local-experiences/#!/e/san-diego-sunset-bay-cruise-1443f61d) and get up to $100 off your cruise and more.
item.location: 1551 Shelter Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92106
item.booking_notes:
We look forward to you joining us!
---
We know you are excited to go on your adventure, but before you do, we want to make sure we go over a few important things that will help make your adventure so much more fun.

##Things to know before arrival

1) Please ensure a Waiver has been filled out for everyone attending the activity.
2) Please make sure you show up 10 minutes before departure. We do depart on time so that everyone can enjoy the most out of the Sunset.

*If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us via email at ahoy@keeneradventures.com or by text/call/Whatsapp at +1(619)350-3258.

---

##Included with your charter

•	Safety Equipment
•	USCG Licensed Captain
•	Complementary Water
•	Complementraty Small Snacks
•	Small Bluetooth Speaker for you and your guests to enjoy music while onboard the vessel
•	a fantastic view of the Sunset

---

## BYOB For this Cruise

We allow you and your party to bring alcoholic beverages on this cruise without charging a Corkage Fee or alcohol fee. Alcohol can be consumed on the cruise if the rules are at [https://keeneradventures.com/rules](https://keeneradventures.com/rules). The rules are as follows:

- No Glass while on the cruise (Our partner rental company does not allow any glass onboard the boats at any time)
- All Guests who will be consuming alcohol must be 21+ and have a Valid ID onboard the boat at all time
- Excessive Intoxication or passengers who cause issues while under the influence will result in activity cancellation with no possibility for a refund

If you or anyone in your party has any questions about this, please feel free to contact us. We will be happy to answer them.

---

##What you can expect:

###If you booked the Duffy Sunset Cruises
• A Quite a relaxing time on the Duffy
• Amazing views of the marinas and some of the yachts that call it home
• Tons of bench style setting with a table and easy views of the water

###If you booked the Regular Private Sunset Cruise
• Bait barge with Sealions and Seabirds
• San Diego Maritime Museum with the Star of India
• Go underneath the USS Midway Museum
• San Diego – Coronado Bay Bridge
and so much more.

---

##Things to Bring

Please make sure you bring the following to your activity:
* And ID for everyone over 21 and will be consuming alcohol while onboard the vessel
* Sweaters, Jackets, or windbreakers (Recommend that you check the weather before arrival to know how cold it will be)
* Hat & Sunglasses
* Cameral or phone to take photos (If you forget this, we will take photos and have them available online for an additional fee)
* A sense of Adventure and some FUN!!!

----

##Parking

We recommend parking on the street in public parking. There is parking on the resort property itself. However, we cannot validate parking at this time. If you purchase a drink or food at the Vessel Restaurant on Property, you may be able to get your parking validated.

---

##Gratuity

Our Captains and/or Crew work hard to make sure you and your party have an outstanding time on the water. If you would like to thank them with a little extra, we highly encourage it. The typical gratuity is 20% of the total cost of the ticket but you can tip however much or little you feel is appropriate. This is of course optional and is never required.
item.cancellation_notes:
**Sales of all reservations and activites are final.** The only exception is if you purchase Trip Protection at the time of reservation. Please see the Trip Protection section below for complete terms.

**Weather / Rain-Check**
If inclement weather results in Keener Adventures canceling a cruise or activity, a full refund will be issued. Keener Adventures will offer this refund via a gift card or a return to the card on file. A Keener Adventures representative will contact you to ensure the refund is processed.

**No-Show**
Keener Adventures will not compensate guests for no-shows for any reason. No credit, compensation, or rescheduling will be offered for cancellations, regardless of whether they purchased Trip Protection.

**TRIP PROTECTION - Highly Recommended**
Trip Protection can be purchased for this activity and allow a rescheduling/refund as long notice is given no less than three days (72 Hours) before the start of this activity. Refunds will be the total minus taxes and fees to the payment method on file. For more information regarding Trip Protection, please visit [https://keeneradventures.com/trip-protection/](https://keeneradventures.com/trip-protection/).

##WHERE TO MEET FOR YOUR ACTIVITY##
Please meet your captain before the activity at La Playa Marketplace. This is located near the adult-only pool on the property and is also the watersport rentals office. Your captain will meet you there and walk down to the vessel with you and your party.

*We highly recommend using the restrooms before the excursion, as there are no public restrooms on the bay.*

##PARKING FOR THE ACTIVITY##
Please note that we do not validate parking. Unless you are staying at Kona Kai, San Diego parking is provided on the street and at the park across from the hotel. That being said, remember to arrive early, as parking can be difficult on weekends, holidays, and during the summer.
